name: Pearl Drop
subtitle: Merkle airdrop
description: Example 13 — a 32-byte Merkle root commits the whole recipient list; claimants prove membership and are paid once before the deadline.
long_description: Distribution without a distribution list on chain. The deployer commits an arbitrary-size recipient list as a single Merkle root at deploy time; each recipient later proves membership with a logarithmic-size proof and is paid their exact committed amount, once. Leaves bind address and amount together, so a stolen proof is useless to anyone else. The claim window closes at an immutable deadline, after which a permissionless sweep returns the entire unclaimed remainder to the fixed distributor — a typo'd root or an abandoned drop can never strand funds. State cost per claim is one slot paid by the claimant, not the deployer: the deployer's entire commitment is 32 bytes.

interface.description: Returns the constant identifier that marks a personal-test deployment policy.
Lets a personal-test token notify this contract of a receipt so the token holding cap is checked; reverts if the cap is exceeded.
Claims the caller's amount in native coin by supplying a Merkle proof; one claim per address and only before the deadline.
Returns whether an address has already claimed.
Returns the claim deadline as a Unix timestamp.
Returns the address that receives the remaining balance after the deadline.
Returns 'personal-test' if deployed under a personal-test policy, otherwise 'testnet'.
Returns the Merkle root that defines who may claim and how much.
Returns whether an account is on this instance's personal-test allow list.
Returns the deployment authority address that vouches for related personal-test instances, or zero when not in personal-test mode.
Returns whether this instance runs under a personal-test policy that limits callers and held value.
Returns the maximum native coin balance this instance may hold in personal-test mode, or zero otherwise.
Returns the owner account of the personal-test policy, or zero when not in personal-test mode.
Returns the personal-test policy tuple: marker, owner, native coin cap and token cap.
Returns the maximum total raw token units this instance may hold in personal-test mode, or zero otherwise.
Adds or removes an account on the personal-test allow list; callable only by the policy owner, who cannot be removed.
After the deadline, sends the whole remaining balance to the distributor; anyone may call it.
Returns the total amount in wei paid out through claims.
